subject: CAIQ artifact manifest + runtime proofing sprint
messages:
From: Jake Morrison <jmorrison@halohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@halohealth.com
Date: Mon, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence request: control manifest & runtime artifacts

Marcus —

Thanks for taking this. We're wrapping up HaloHealth's CAIQ intake and need a compact artifact manifest that ties Redwood's CAIQ answers to tangible evidence. For this intake please: 

- Provide a control crosswalk (CAIQ/CCM ID -> Redwood control owner) in XLSX.
- Produce an artifact manifest (PDF or CSV) listing the artifact name, control(s) it supports, owner, storage location, and retention period.
- For a small sample, include runtime artifacts relevant to inference: inference request logs, KV/cache retention logs, model-variant fallback logs, and telemetry sampling output. Parquet or gzipped CSV is fine for logs.

Specifically we need enough to cover the in-scope controls in categories: Asset Management, Logging/Monitoring, Data Protection, and Resiliency (approx ~25 controls). Can you confirm redaction requirements (we'll accept redacted or hashed identifiers) and whether you can deliver a first-pass package by Thu Aug 5 17:00 PDT?

If you prefer, a quick 20-30m walkthrough of the manifest would help our security team.

Appreciate it —
Jake Morrison
Information Security Manager
HaloHealth
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morrison <jmorrison@halohealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request: control manifest & runtime artifacts

Hi Jake —

Thanks, we can do that. High-level plan (deliverables):

1) CAIQ crosswalk XLSX: mapping for each CAIQ question/CCM control -> Redwood control/owner.
2) Artifact manifest (PDF): ledger with artifact filename, short description, control linkage, retention, and secure storage path.
3) Runtime sample: sanitized/parquet runtime logs (30k rows truncated to 7 days), KV/cache retention excerpt, and model-fallback trace sample.
4) Owner roster + contact info and a short narrated walkthrough (10–15m recording) if you want a recording instead of live call.

Timeline we can hit: initial package by Tue Aug 3 COB (PDT) — that will include the crosswalk and manifest plus a small set of runtime artifacts. If you want extended samples or additional retention windows (e.g., 90 days) we can follow up by Thu Aug 5.

Two quick clarifying Qs:
- Do you need PII redaction beyond opaque user ids (we typically hash user identifiers in shared logs)?
- For the KV/cache retention excerpt, do you want a policy excerpt only, or the operational retention logs as well?

If a walkthrough is helpful, I'm available Wed/Thu afternoons; otherwise Kimberly will drop the package into a shared Drive folder.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Jake —

Attaching our first-pass package as discussed. Notes below and attachment descriptions.

Attachments included (stubs):
- halohealth_caiq_map_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB): CAIQ -> Redwood control crosswalk. Each row lists CAIQ question ID, short answer reference, and owner.
- runtime_artifact_manifest.pdf (PDF, 230 KB): Artifact ledger with control links, storage paths (internal Drive IDs), retention statements, and owner contact.
- runtime_logs_sample.parquet (Parquet, ~3 MB): Sanitized runtime sample (7-day slice). Identifiers hashed; timestamps preserved.

A couple of implementation notes:
- PII: logs in runtime_logs_sample.parquet have user ids hashed with salted SHA256. We did not include full payloads or prompt contents — only metadata needed to demonstrate logging and retention behavior.
- KV/cache retention: the manifest points to a policy excerpt and an operational retention log excerpt. If you want the raw operational logs it's a small extra step (we'll need to coordinate SIEM ingestion redaction).

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExample (read-only; expiration 30 days).

Kimberly / Marcus —

Received the package, thanks for the quick turnaround. The crosswalk and manifest look good at a glance. A couple of small asks before we move the CAIQ into our reviewers: 

- Can you include a one-page excerpt of the KV/cache retention policy (policy text + effective date)? That helps our auditors validate intended retention vs. observed retention.
- For the runtime_logs_sample.parquet, can you also include a short README describing the column schema and the hashing approach used for identifiers?

If you're available, we'd like a 30-minute walkthrough next week (Tue/Wed afternoon PT). Otherwise the recorded walkthrough is fine — please include a timestamped index so reviewers can jump to the runtime/retention sections.

Proposing Tue Aug 10 1:00–1:30 PM PT; if that works I can calendar invite.

Thanks again —
Jake Morrison
Information Security Manager
HaloHealth
